answer: Each agent must stake a unique sable token whose on-chain pigment hash encodes a verifiable biometric or hardware fingerprint, making duplicate identities detectable before registration. When a new agent joins, peers broadcast an echo challenge requiring proof of stake ownership signed with that fingerprint. Duplicating an identity forces the attacker to acquire and lock a second costly stake plus a distinct fingerprint, raising forgery cost far above potential epoch rewards.
